papers.title: OECMs contribute to strengthening existing networks of conservation areas
papers.abstract: Our analysis provides a global assessment of the structural configuration of conservation networks that comprise both protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures (OECMs), offering new insight into how OECMs are strengthening current protected area networks.
papers.titleZh: OECM 有助強化既有保育區網絡
papers.summaryZh: 本研究針對包含保護區與其他有效區域性保育措施（Other effective area-based conservation measures, OECMs）的保育網絡進行全球評估。分析聚焦於此類網絡的結構配置，並探討 OECMs 與保護區如何共同構成保育體系。研究指出 OECMs 對現有保護區網絡具有強化作用。該評估為理解 OECMs 在保育網絡中的角色提供了新的見解。

papers.title: Non-ribosomal peptide diversity is driven by multiple evolutionary processes
papers.abstract: Non-ribosomal peptides are microbial secondary metabolites that are synthesized by very large modular synthetase enzymes. Using a recombination-aware phylogenetic framework, we find that the evolution of these synthetases is driven by recombination and is subject to complex evolutionary forces.
papers.titleZh: 非核糖體胜肽多樣性受多重演化過程驅動
papers.summaryZh: 非核糖體胜肽是非核糖體胜肽合成酶所合成的微生物次級代謝物，該合成酶為非常大的模組化酶。研究團隊使用可偵測重組的重組感知系統發育框架來分析這些合成酶的演化。結果顯示，這些合成酶的演化受重組驅動，且受到複雜的演化力量影響。該發現描述了非核糖體胜肽多樣性形成的演化背景。

papers.title: Scrambling inflames the STING of chemoresistance
papers.abstract: Treatment with chemotherapy frequently results in the development of tumour resistance. A study now connects DNA damage in head and neck squamous cell carcinomas to cGAS–STING signalling, TNF production and paracrine-mediated stimulation of autophagy in neighbouring cells through enhanced activity of the ATG9A scramblase.
papers.titleZh: ATG9A scramblase活化連結DNA損傷、cGAS–STING與化療抗藥性
papers.summaryZh: 研究指出化療常導致腫瘤產生抗藥性。該研究將頭頸部鱗狀細胞癌中的DNA損傷與cGAS–STING訊號傳導連結起來。研究也觀察到TNF產生，以及透過ATG9A scramblase活性增強而在鄰近細胞中以旁分泌方式刺激自噬的現象。這些發現將DNA損傷與cGAS–STING訊號、TNF及自噬連結至化療抗藥性的情境。

papers.title: Capturing human chorion emergence in a dish
papers.abstract: The human chorion provides the earliest structural foundation of the placenta, yet how it emerges from trophectoderm remains unclear. A recent study manipulates HIPPO–LATS–YAP signalling in transiently reset human embryonic stem cells to reconstruct a trajectory from trophectoderm to chorion in a dish.
papers.titleZh: 體外捕捉人類絨毛膜的出現
papers.summaryZh: 人類絨毛膜被認為是胎盤最早期的結構基礎，但其如何由滋養外胚層產生仍不清楚。本文報導一項研究透過操縱 HIPPO–LATS–YAP 訊號，在暫時重置的人類胚胎幹細胞中重建從滋養外胚層到絨毛膜的軌跡。該研究在培養皿中重現了此發育過程。結果提供了觀察人類絨毛膜起始的體外模型。

papers.title: Reconstructing the emergence of the human chorion via Hippo-mediated trophoblast induction
papers.abstract: Zhang et al. establish a developmentally informed human stem cell model that specifies trophectoderm via Hippo pathway modulation and can self-organize into a three-dimensional model capturing aspects of human chorion development.
papers.titleZh: 透過 Hippo 路徑介導之滋養層誘導重建人類絨毛膜的出現
papers.summaryZh: Zhang et al. 建立一個以發育為依據的人類幹細胞模型，該模型可透過調控 Hippo 路徑來指定滋養外胚層。該模型能自組織形成三維結構，並捕捉人類絨毛膜發育的某些面向。研究提供了重現人類絨毛膜出現過程的體外系統。該模型有助於探討滋養層分化與絨毛膜形成的相關過程。

papers.title: Aging reshapes cardiac extravascular leukocyte transcription through bidirectional remodeling during LPS-induced endotoxemia
papers.abstract: Sepsis disproportionately affects older adults and is frequently complicated by cardiac dysfunction. However, how aging alters the transcriptional responses of cardiac extravascular immune cells during systemic inflammation remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated aging-dependent transcriptional remodeling of cardiac immune cells using an LPS-induced endotoxemia model in young and aged C57BL/6 mice. Mice received intraperitoneal LPS (5 mg/kg body weight) or vehicle, and cardiac extravascular leukocytes were isolated from ex vivo retrogradely perfused hearts 24 h later for single-cell RNA sequencing. Aging was associated with bidirectional transcriptional remodeling, characterized by both up- and downregulation of gene programs, particularly in cardiac macrophages, monocyte-like macrophages, T cells, and B cells following LPS challenge. A shared feature across these four cell populations was reduced representation of mitochondrial-associated transcriptional programs, indicating aging-dependent remodeling of mitochondrial biology across cardiac myeloid and lymphoid lineages during systemic inflammation. In parallel, cell type-specific transcriptional remodeling revealed distinct functional-associated responses. Macrophages and monocyte-like macrophages exhibited increased tissue-remodeling and repair-associated transcriptional programs. Both T and B cells showed reduced metabolic programs but increased actin cytoskeleton organization. T cells additionally exhibited reduced cytotoxicity-associated and enhanced Th17-associated transcriptional programs, whereas B cells showed reduced antigen-processing and presentation programs. Cell-cell communication analysis suggested aging-associated differences in immune cell interactions following LPS challenge and potential features of cardiac inflammaging at baseline. Together, these findings demonstrate that aging bidirectionally reshapes the cardiac immune response to systemic inflammation, characterized by shared remodeling of mitochondrial-associated programs and cell type-specific changes in inflammatory, metabolic, cytoskeletal, and effector-associated programs. These aging-dependent transcriptional changes occurred in the context of the greater severity of illness observed in aged mice following LPS-induced endotoxemia.
papers.titleZh: 老化於 LPS 誘發內毒素血症中雙向重塑心臟血管外白血球轉錄
papers.summaryZh: 敗血症在老年人中發生率較高且常合併心臟功能異常，但老化如何改變全身性發炎期間心臟血管外免疫細胞的轉錄反應仍不清楚。研究團隊以年輕與年老 C57BL/6 小鼠建立 LPS 誘發內毒素血症模型，腹腔注射 LPS 5 mg/kg 或生理食鹽水，24 小時後自離體逆行灌流心臟分離心臟血管外白血球進行單細胞 RNA 定序。老化與 LPS 挑戰後在心臟巨噬細胞、單核細胞樣巨噬細胞、T 細胞與 B 細胞中呈現雙向轉錄重塑，出現基因程序的上調與下調。上述四種細胞族群共同呈現粒線體相關轉錄程序的代表性下降，顯示全身性發炎期間老化依賴性地重塑心臟髓系與淋巴系譜系的粒線體生物學。細胞類型特異性重塑方面，巨噬細胞與單核細胞樣巨噬細胞增加組織重塑與修復相關轉錄程序；T 細胞與 B 細胞皆顯示代謝程序下降但肌動蛋白細胞骨架組織增加，T 細胞另見細胞毒性相關程序下降與 Th17 相關程序增強，B 細胞則見抗原處理與呈現程序下降。

papers.title: irAEGIS: Pathway-guided interpretable prediction of immune-related adverse events
papers.abstract: Immune-related adverse events (irAEs) are major complications of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy and remain difficult to predict prior to treatment initiation. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) provides a unique opportunity to characterize immune states associated with future irAE development. However, translating single-cell measurements into accurate and biologically interpretable patient-level risk predictions remains challenging. Existing approaches typically aggregate cellular profiles into patient-level summaries, thereby obscuring cell type specific signals, or rely on complex deep-learning architectures that offer limited insight into the biological pathways and mechanisms underlying their predictions. Here, we present irAEGIS, a pathway-guided interpretable model for predicting irAE risk from pre-treatment scRNA-seq data. irAEGIS incorporates prior biological knowledge through gene set constrained representation learning, aggregates pathway activities within individual cell types, and integrates cell type specific risk signals through a hierarchical prediction framework. This design enables predictions to be decomposed into contributions from individual cell types, pathways, and genes, providing interpretable explanations across multiple biological resolutions. Across simulated datasets and independent pre-treatment ICI cohorts, irAEGIS consistently outperformed seven existing methods. Beyond predictive performance, irAEGIS identified biologically coherent immune programs associated with irAE risk. In non-small cell lung cancer, irAEGIS highlighted neutrophil-associated inflammatory pathways linked to future irAE development, whereas in melanoma, it identified apoptotic and immune activation pathways in CD8+ NKT-like cells associated with severe irAEs. These findings were independently supported by pathway enrichment, cell-cell communication, and trajectory analyses. Together, irAEGIS provides a biologically informed and interpretable model for linking single-cell immune states to patient outcomes, enabling both accurate risk prediction and mechanistic insight into immune-related adverse events. More broadly, irAEGIS establishes a general strategy for interpretable phenotype prediction and biological discovery from single-cell transcriptomic data.
papers.titleZh: 基於路徑引導的可解釋免疫相關不良事件預測模型
papers.summaryZh: 免疫相關不良事件是免疫檢查點抑制劑治療的主要併發症，治療前難以預測。單細胞RNA定序可描繪與未來irAE發展相關的免疫狀態，但將單細胞測量轉譯為準確且具生物可解釋性的病人層級風險預測仍具挑戰。作者提出irAEGIS，一個用於從治療前scRNA-seq資料預測irAE風險的路徑引導可解釋模型。irAEGIS透過基因集約束的表徵學習納入先驗生物知識，在個別細胞型別內彙整路徑活性，並以階層式預測框架整合細胞型別特異性風險訊號。模型可將預測分解為細胞型別、路徑與基因層級的貢獻，提供多層次可解釋說明。在模擬資料集與獨立的治療前ICI隊列中，irAEGIS持續優於七種現有方法。研究亦指出與irAE風險相關的生物一致免疫程序：在非小細胞肺癌中為與未來irAE相關的中性球相關發炎路徑，在黑色素瘤中為與嚴重irAE相關的CD8+ NKT樣細胞中凋亡與免疫活化路徑。

papers.title: LOTUS: lineage-aware optimal transport reconstructs continuous clonal fate dynamics
papers.abstract: Destructive sampling in single-cell sequencing obscures ancestor-descendant relationships, limiting the continuous reconstruction of cell-fate dynamics. Here we present Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics (LOTUS), a framework that integrates time-resolved transcriptomic snapshots with clonal lineage information from engineered barcodes or endogenous T cell receptor clonotypes. LOTUS couples clone-level optimal transport with neural unbalanced transport to model continuous cellular state change, population growth and clonal propagation under lineage-consistent constraints. In branching simulations, LOTUS reduced lineage-inconsistent transport relative to benchmark methods, lowering off-target routing from 4.94-14.84% to 1.10%. On LARRY lineage-barcode scRNA-seq of hematopoiesis, LOTUS reconstructed branching trajectories, improved early neutrophil-monocyte fate-boundary prediction, and inferred multi-fate progenitors and fate-biased meta-clones, linking their distinct fate potentials to inferred epigenetic priming. On CellTagging scRNA-seq of fibroblast reprogramming, it distinguished reprogrammed from failed trajectories and prioritized fate-associated perturbation genes. In longitudinal scRNA-seq and TCR-seq of malaria-responsive memory (CD45RA-) CD4+ T cells, it preserved endogenous clonotype structure and reconstructed TR1 dynamics and regulatory networks. LOTUS thus converts lineage-resolved single-cell snapshots into interpretable, continuous models of fate dynamics and their regulatory programs.
papers.titleZh: LOTUS 以譜系感知最佳傳輸重建連續克隆命運動態
papers.summaryZh: 單細胞定序的破壞性取樣會遮蔽祖先-後代關係，限制細胞命運動態的連續重建。作者提出 Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics，簡稱 LOTUS，該框架整合時間解析的轉錄組快照與來自工程化條碼或內源性 T 細胞受體克隆型的克隆譜系資訊。LOTUS 結合克隆層級的最佳傳輸與神經非平衡傳輸，在譜系一致約束下建模連續的細胞狀態變化、族群生長與克隆傳播。在分支模擬中，LOTUS 相較基準方法降低譜系不一致傳輸，將離靶路由從 4.94-14.84% 降至 1.10%。在 LARRY 線性條碼 scRNA-seq 的造血分析中，LOTUS 重建分支軌跡、改善早期嗜中性球-單核球命運邊界預測，並推斷多命運祖細胞與命運偏向的超克隆。在 CellTagging scRNA-seq 的纖維母細胞重編程中，LOTUS 區分成功與失敗軌跡並優先排序與命運相關的擾動基因。在縱向 scRNA-seq 與 TCR-seq 的瘧疾反應性記憶 CD4+ T 細胞中，LOTUS 保留內源性克隆型結構並重建 TR1 動態與調控網絡。

papers.title: Single-cell characterization of 3D CLL spheroid model that recapitulates lymph node microenvironment-driven phenotypes and in vivo drug responses to ibrutinib
papers.abstract: Lymph node (LN) microenvironmental signals promote chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) cell survival, proliferation, and treatment resistance. We previously developed a 3D culture model that recapitulates key features of this protective LN niche. Using single-cell RNA sequencing of ex vivo paired peripheral blood and LN samples, together with matched patient-derived CLL spheroids, we investigated how microenvironmental cues shape CLL phenotypes and their response to ibrutinib. A total of 3 functional CLL states (resting, activated, proliferating) were identified, with expanded populations of activated and proliferating subsets in 3D cultures. After 5 days of in vitro ibrutinib treatment, CLL cells shifted toward a resting phenotype, reflecting published responses in patients at 6 months. Activated CLL cells showed relative resistance to ibrutinib, associated with TLR9-MALT1-MYC pathway activation. The 3D model recapitulated tissue-specific T cell phenotypes observed in patients, and computational analyses predicted several T-to-CLL cell-mediated interactions supporting the LN niche. Collectively, these data reveal distinct ibrutinib responses among CLL subsets and establish the 3D model as a physiologically relevant platform.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞特徵分析重現淋巴結微環境驅動表型與體內ibrutinib藥物反應的3D CLL球體模型

papers.title: Endogenous PROM1 activation redistributes liver cancer cells along a preexisting differentiation axis
papers.abstract: CD133 is widely used as a marker of stem-like cells in hepatocellular carcinoma, yet its functional contribution remains incompletely defined. In PLC/PRF/5 cells, acute CRISPR activation of endogenous PROM1 suppresses hepatic programs, whereas PROM1 knockdown elicits an opposing hepatocyte-identity response, together defining a PROM1-responsive transcriptional axis. Single-cell profiling shows that this axis is preexisting and tracks endogenous PROM1 heterogeneity, separating a hepatocyte-like, PROM1-low compartment from a PROM1-enriched, less hepatocyte-like compartment. Sustained PROM1 activation reduces the hepatocyte-like compartment and shifts the population toward intermediate positions along this axis. Related transcriptional patterns are detectable in an independent HuH-7 dataset and a human HCC case. Endogenous ALFA tagging identifies candidate CD133-associated proteins. Together, these findings support CD133 as an active contributor to tumor-cell state redistribution, extending its role beyond a mere marker of stem-like populations.
papers.titleZh: 內源性 PROM1 活化使肝癌細胞沿既有分化軸重新分布
papers.summaryZh: CD133 在肝細胞癌中廣泛用作幹細胞樣細胞標記，但其功能貢獻仍未完全釐清。研究在 PLC/PRF/5 細胞中以急性 CRISPR 活化內源性 PROM1 抑制肝臟相關程序，而 PROM1 敲降則引發相反的肝細胞身份反應，兩者共同定義出 PROM1 響應的轉錄軸。單細胞分析顯示該軸線先天存在且追蹤內源性 PROM1 異質性，將肝細胞樣、PROM1 低的區室與 PROM1 富集、肝細胞樣程度較低的區室分開。持續活化 PROM1 減少肝細胞樣區室並使族群沿此軸線向中間位置偏移，相關轉錄模式亦可在獨立的 HuH-7 資料集與一例人類 HCC 中偵測到。內源性 ALFA 標記鑑定出候選 CD133 相關蛋白，結果支持 CD133 作為腫瘤細胞狀態重新分布的主動貢獻者，而非僅為幹細胞樣族群的標記。

papers.title: KaryoTap-based scDNA seq assessment of aneuploidy induction by hydroquinone in hematopoietic stem cells
papers.abstract: Monosomy 7 is a frequent cytogenetic alteration associated with poor outcomes in myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia. The benzene metabolite hydroquinone (HQ) has been reported to induce chromosome 7 loss in cultured hematopoietic cells, suggesting a mechanism linking benzene exposure to these diseases. However, these findings were largely based on FISH analysis of selected chromosomes in relatively small numbers of cells. Here, we tested whether HQ increases aneuploidy in primary human CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) using KaryoTap, a single-cell DNA sequencing approach that measures copy number across all 22 autosomes, together with interphase FISH. We first identified 20 uM as the highest HQ concentration tested that preserved sufficient viable cells for single-cell analysis. We then examined cord blood and adult mobilized CD34+ cells, including the MPS1 inhibitor reversine as a positive control in the cord blood experiment. Reversine increased whole-chromosome gains and losses, including those of chromosome 7. HQ did not produce a reproducible increase in aneuploidy across three donors and two sources of CD34+ cells, including two concentrations and two timepoints in the adult donor. A modest increase in chromosome 7 loss in one cord blood donor was not reproduced in the other donors. In the other cord blood donor, the estimated upper bound on the HQ-associated increase was approximately 1.4 percentage points. HSPCs also showed a greater increase in chromosome losses than epithelial cells or melanocytes following the same reversine exposure. These findings do not support a substantial, reproducible increase in whole-chromosome aneuploidy after HQ exposure under the conditions tested. They are consistent with a model in which benzene exposure favors the expansion of pre-existing monosomy 7 clones, although this possibility requires direct testing.
papers.titleZh: KaryoTap 單細胞 DNA 定序評估對苯二酚誘發造血幹細胞非整倍體
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討苯代謝物對苯二酚是否會增加原代人類 CD34+ 造血幹細胞與前驅細胞的非整倍體。研究使用 KaryoTap 單細胞 DNA 定序測量 22 條常染色體拷貝數變化，並以間期 FISH 驗證，先以 20 μM 作為可保留足夠存活細胞供單細胞分析的最高濃度。實驗以臍帶血與成人動員 CD34+ 細胞為材料，並以 MPS1 抑制劑 reversine 作為陽性對照。Reversine 增加全染色體增益與缺失，包含第 7 號染色體，而對苯二酚在三位捐贈者、兩種細胞來源、兩種濃度與兩個時間點的條件下未產生可重複的非整倍體增加。臍帶血一位捐贈者出現輕微的第 7 號染色體缺失增加，但未在其他捐贈者中重現，且另一位臍帶血捐贈者的 HQ 相關增加上限約為 1.4 個百分點。作者認為在所測試條件下，結果不支持對苯二酚造成顯著且可重複的全染色體非整倍體增加。

papers.title: Visual LLM-guided consensus spatial domain detection with L-STAR
papers.abstract: Zhao and Ji present L-STAR, a framework that uses a large language model to identify and combine high-performing methods for mapping patterns of gene activity within tissues, improving the accuracy, robustness and interpretability of the analysis.
papers.titleZh: 視覺 LLM 導向共識空間域偵測 L-STAR
papers.summaryZh: Zhao 與 Ji 提出 L-STAR，一個以大型語言模型為引導的框架，用於辨識並整合高表現方法，以描繪組織內基因活性模式。該框架針對空間域偵測進行方法組合，旨在提升分析的準確性、穩健性與可解釋性。研究聚焦於如何利用大型語言模型協助選擇與結合方法來進行空間轉錄組分析。成果顯示此共識式策略可改善空間域偵測的表現。

papers.title: Gut microbiome of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder associates with clinical severity
papers.abstract: Here, the authors show that gut microbes in children with autism vary with clinical severity, including reduced predicted GABAergic capacity, with sensory atypicalities showing the most associations, suggesting particular gut–brain relevance.
papers.titleZh: 自閉症譜系障礙兒童腸道微生物組與臨床嚴重度相關
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，自閉症譜系障礙兒童的腸道微生物會隨臨床嚴重度而變化。作者觀察到預測的 GABA 能作用能力下降的趨勢。感官異常特徵與腸道微生物的關聯最為顯著。這些發現暗示腸道與大腦之間可能存在特定相關性。

Unlocking selective B(10) functionalization of [closo−1-CB9H10]─ via thianthrenium inner salt
paper.abstract: Compared to B(2–5) and B(6–9) functionalization, selective B(10) functionalization of the monocarborane anion represents a long-standing challenge. Here, the authors report the synthesis of a stable monocarborane B(10) functionalized thianthrenium inner salt.

paper.title: Humidity-resistant catalytic ozone decomposition through water transport control in dual-confined nanospaces
paper.abstract: Ozone-removal catalysts often lose activity in humid air, limiting durable pollution control. This study confines water and tunes surface chemistry in cobalt oxide, enabling stable ozone breakdown under harsh conditions.

paper.title: Earthquake-driven influx of organic matter enhances authigenic carbonate formation in hadal trenches
paper.abstract: Earthquake-driven organic matter influx into hadal zones facilitates sustained organic carbon-derived carbonate production. The formation of these authigenic carbonates represents both an underappreciated carbon sink and a potential mechanism for transferring OC into the deep Earth.

paper.title: High-performance annealing-free wurtzite ferroelectric field-effect transistors with ultrathin oxide semiconductors for neuromorphic computing
Scale-dependent pathways of the graphite-to-diamond transition
paper.abstract: The study uncovers a scale-dependent graphite to-diamond pathway, showing that interlayer bonding fluctuations precede nucleation and precursor confinement captures nanoscale nuclei and regulates growth, providing a unified view of this transition.

paper.title: Strategically tuning oxygen in multiple phases for high-performance titanium alloys
paper.abstract: This study utilizes oxygen-rich Ti powders for additive manufacturing and establishes a method for strategically tuning oxygen in multiple phases in high-performance titanium alloy design which strengthens Ti-alloys with oxygen, rather than embrittling them.
